intent: Change DELETE /tasks/{id} from a hard delete to a soft delete: add a nullable deletedAt timestamp to the task model (serialized as deletedAt, null when active), set it on DELETE and return 204 instead of removing the row, hide soft-deleted tasks from GET /tasks and GET /tasks/{id} (404), and expose them via GET /tasks?includeDeleted=true. The four seeded tasks must remain active after startup (backward-compatible migration of existing rows).
